title: Does Mercor's AI Interview Cut You Off? #Shorts
description:
Extended silence can make the AI interrupt you. So think out loud, or say that you are thinking. If it does cut in mid-answer, you are allowed to tell it you were not finished — and you can ask it to repeat or rephrase.

Full breakdown of how Mercor works: https://youtu.be/Dd5UFR0pfvg
Source: talent.docs.mercor.com/support/ai-interview

Nothing here is a guarantee of work, acceptance, or income.
